ExamBatch.title: ExamBatch
ExamBatch.description: A set or batch of exam questions belonging to a folder or exam category

folderId.description: Folder or subcategory identifier such as pyq-2025-exams or english_sectional_test

subjectId.description: Parent subject identifier such as pyq, gk, english

description.description: Optional description of the batch content

questions.description: Array of question objects included in this batch

MistakeItem.title: MistakeItem
MistakeItem.description: A question saved to the Mistake Notebook for targeted revision and practice

id.description: Unique identifier for the mistake entry

category.description: Categorization of the mistake (concept_gap, silly_mistake, etc.)

selectedOptionIndex.description: Option index selected by user during test

userNotes.description: Personal reflection notes written by the learner

savedAt.description: Epoch timestamp when mistake was recorded

/exam_batches/{batchId}.description: All question batches created or uploaded across folders

/mistake_notebook/{mistakeId}.description: Saved mistakes for review and re-test
